app.title: Gene Expression Visualizer (flask-scrna-spermatogenesis)
app.summary: A person uploads a text file of gene names, one per line, or types a comma-separated list, and can choose z-score normalization. On submit, the genes are looked up in a stored table that holds one expression value per developmental stage. Genes with missing values or flat profiles are dropped. The person gets back three static plots: one line per gene across the ordered stages, the mean, median and quartiles across the chosen genes at each stage, and a heatmap that clusters the genes by profile with the stages kept in order.

task.text: See how a chosen set of genes is expressed across the ordered stages of a developmental process, summarised across the set and grouped by profile shape.

data.text: A processed expression table with one row per gene and one column per ordered stage. Each value is the gene's average expression in that stage, given in TP10K. The input is a list of gene symbols.
data.item: a gene with its expression profile across the ordered stages

stage.text: exploring expression patterns of a gene list in a processed single-cell atlas, before deeper analysis

mechanism.text: A single form takes the gene list and a z-score checkbox and posts to the server. The server filters the stage-by-gene table, optionally z-scores each gene and returns rendered images: a per-gene line chart, a line chart of summary statistics and a row-clustered heatmap.

field.text: stage-resolved gene expression profiling from single-cell RNA-seq in biology

workflow.name: chart a chosen set of items' profiles across ordered conditions, summarise them and cluster them by shape
